reuse.why: Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount, but transaction downloading and local unlink cleanup repeat existing logic.

duplication.why: The change repeats validation orchestration across six handlers, copies the local unlink field reset, and adds another substantially identical transaction downloader.

placement.why: The changes follow the existing account, sync, configuration, and model layers, although shared link validation remains distributed across provider handlers.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested linking rules, Fintegra integration, associated types, and tests.

maintainability.why: Shared guards reduce rule duplication, but an assertion that conditionally unlinks accounts hides mutation and duplicates cleanup that must remain aligned with unlinkAccount.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Fintegra uses the existing bank and linking helpers; unlinkAccount includes provider side effects and offers no reusable local-only cleanup operation.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes the existing downloaders' token lookup, authenticated POST, error handling, and response mapping with renamed variables and an inline return.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and branches for refusal versus local unlinking, turning a validation helper into a conditional mutation; all six linking handlers call the shared guards.
